SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Special Branch ~~xs~~ 856
REPORT
Date October 27 1937.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Municipality Youth Circles' National Salvation
Association.

Made by ............ and ............ Forwarded by C.D.I. Ross

With reference to the instructions of the
D.C.(Sp.Br.) on the attached extract from the Intelligence
Report dated October 25, 1937, Mr. Pan Tung Jui (潘東如),
a representative of the Preparatory Office of the Shanghai
Municipality Youth Circles' National Salvation Association,
No. 10 Sing Ping Li (信平里), Lungmen Road, was interviewed
at Police Headquarters on October 26. He was warned that
propaganda in the form of distribution of handbills, pasting
of posters, shouting of slogans and delivery of lectures
would not be tolerated in the Settlement, although collection
of voluntary contributions and comforts for refugees and
wounded soldiers is permitted. He was also warned to register
his association in accordance with an order issued by the
Municipal Council.

Mr. Pan was advised to submit any programme for
propaganda purposes to the Municipal Police one week in advance
for investigation and approval.

（左侧批注：Watch / 3B / S.I. / For attention / D.C.）

D. C. (Special Branch)            C. D. I.

日期：1937年10月27日。

主题（全称）上海市青年界救亡协会。

制作人 ____ 及 ____ 转呈人 C.D.I. Ross

参照附上的1937年10月25日情报报告摘录中特别处副总监（D.C.(Sp.Br.)）的指示，上海市青年界救亡协会筹备处代表潘東如（Pan Tung Jui），住址龙门路信平里10号，于10月26日在警察总局接受问询。他受到警告，虽然允许为难民和伤兵募集自愿捐款及慰问品，但在租界内不容忍以散发传单、张贴海报、高呼口号和发表演讲等形式进行的宣传。他还被警告须按照工部局发布的命令对其协会进行注册。

已建议潘先生将任何用于宣传目的的活动计划提前一周提交给市警察局，以便调查和批准。

（左侧批注：监视 / 3B / S.I. / 供注意 / D.C.）

特别处副总监            C. D. I.

October 25, 1937.

- 3 -

Shanghai Municipality Youth Circles' National
Salvation Association - formation

At a meeting of nine representatives of local
young men's national salvation organizations held in
the Chinese Y.M.C.A., 123 Boulevard de Montigny,
between 2.30 p.m. and 4.45 p.m. October 24, it was
decided to form a "Shanghai Municipality Youth Circles'
National Salvation Association (上海市青年界救亡協會 )
for the purpose of unifying the national salvation
activities of local young men's organizations. The
temporary address of the new organization will be at
No.10 Sing Ping Li (信平里), Lungmen Road, where
registration of organizations willing to join the new
body will be held between October 26 and 29.

It was also decided to post 10,000 posters every
day in furtherance of the anti-Japanese and national
salvation movement.

Trade Associations - receive circular notification
from Chinese Chamber of Commerce

On October 23, the various trade associations in
Shanghai received a circular notification from the
Chinese Chamber of Commerce temporarily situated at
480 Yu Ya Ching Road. The notification contains a
suggestion from the Vocational Circles Association to
Save the Nation that shop keepers be advised to print
on paper wrappers words to the effect that their shops
do not deal in Japanese goods and asks their co-
operation in carrying out the above propaganda scheme.

S. I.
For a reference
DBR 26/10

1937年10月25日。

- 3 -

上海市青年界救亡协会——成立

10月24日下午2时30分至4时45分，在蒙自路123号中华基督教青年会举行的当地九个青年救亡组织代表会议上，决定成立“上海市青年界救亡协会”，旨在统一当地青年组织的救亡活动。新组织的临时地址设在龙门路信平里10号，愿意加入该新团体的组织将于10月26日至29日在此登记。

会议还决定每天张贴一万张海报，以推进抗日救亡运动。

同业公会——收到华商总商会的通函通知

10月23日，上海各同业公会收到了暂设于虞洽卿路480号的华商总商会发出的通函通知。该通知包含职业界救国会的建议，即劝告店主在包装纸上印有本店不经营日货等字样的内容，并请求他们合作执行上述宣传方案。

S. I.
供参考
DBR 26/10

REPORT    Date October 26, 1937.

Subject The Shanghai Municipality Youth Circles' National Salvation
Association - formation.

Made by D.I. Kan Lien-pih    Forwarded by C. **〔此处转录不清〕**

At a meeting of nine representatives of local young
men's national salvation organizations held in the Chinese
Y.M.C.A., 123 Boulevard de Montigny (French Concession), between
2.30 p.m. and 4.45 p.m., October 24, it was decided to form a
上海市青年界救亡協會
"Shanghai Municipality Youth Circles' National Salvation
Association" for the purpose of uniting the national salvation
activities of local young men's organizations. The temporary
address of the new organization will be at No.10 Sing Ping Li
(信平里), Lungmen Road, where a registration of organizations
willing to join the body will be held between October 26 and 28.
The following were elected to serve on the preparatory
committee of the new body:-

Chang Yu Liang (張裕良), representative of the Youths
National Salvation Service Group, 370 Avenue Edward VII.
Mr. Chang is the general secretary of the China Aviation
Construction Society, 123 Boulevard de Montigny.

Tsang Shu Shing (章樹), representative of the Chinese
Youths' Conference (中國青年座談會).

Zung Ts Liang (鄭子良), representative of the People's
Lecture Party to Save the Country, No.10 Sing Ping Li,
Lungmen Road. This individual is a prominent leader of
the "Red Pang" an organization of the loafer classes, and
Chairman of Yah Nyi Zoe (俠義社) Society, at the
above address.

Zung Kuh Wen (鄭克文), representative of the Shanghai Munici-
年服務團 上海市國難青
pality National Crisis Youths Service Group, No.1422
Avenue Edward VII. Mr. Zung is the headmaster of the Zung
Kwang Foreign Language School, situated at Lane 1292,
No. 7 Avenue Edward VII.

主题：上海市青年界救亡协会——成立。

制作人：警探长 Kan Lien-pih    转呈人：C. **〔此处转录不清〕**

10月24日下午2时30分至4时45分，在蒙自路123号中华基督教青年会（法租界）举行的当地九个青年救亡组织代表会议上，决定成立“上海市青年界救亡协会”，旨在联合当地青年组织的救亡活动。新组织的临时地址设在龙门路信平里10号，愿意加入该团体的组织将于10月26日至28日在此登记。以下人员当选为新团体的筹备委员会委员：

張裕良（Chang Yu Liang），青年救亡服务团代表，爱德华七世路370号。张先生是中国航空建设协会秘书长，该协会位于蒙自路123号。

章樹欽（Tsang Shu Shing，原文为章樹，后文表格补全为章樹欽），中国青年座谈会（中國青年座談會）代表。

鄭子良（Zung Ts Liang），民众宣讲救国会代表，龙门路信平里10号。此人是“红帮”（一个流氓阶层组织）的著名头目，也是上述地址的俠義社（Yah Nyi Zoe）社长。

鄭克文（Zung Kuh Wen），上海市国难青年服务团（原文残缺：年服務團 上海市國難青）代表，爱德华七世路1422号。郑先生是郑光外语学校校长，该校位于爱德华七世路7号1292弄。
